result.strongest_objection: Premise-verification failure on the single most load-bearing fact in the doc: what physics/schwarzschild.gd actually reads. The DYNAMIC row example and mutants M1–M3 name witnesses data/lens/lens_fwd.bin and lens_inv.bin built via 'physics/schwarzschild.gd:22 (LENS_DIR)', but no verification-log row quotes that line or any line of schwarzschild.gd — while the doc's own measured pack (V8) contains only lens_fwd.json and lens_inv.json and states the .bin files are absent from the clone. The doc demonstrates (V19) that it knows how to pin a dynamic path by quoting ship_commons.gd:4-5, yet the dev.23-motivated lens case — the entire raison d'être of the audit — is recalled, not measured, and sits in unresolved tension with V8. If the code constructs .json paths (plausible, since V9/V8 show JSON auto-packs), then the named witnesses testify about files nothing reads, the 'witness fails F' kill conditions in M1/M2 are wrong (a .json witness passes F under the narrowed 'data/lens/*.json' filter in M2), and AC4's claim that removing data/lens/* reproduces the dev.23 regression turns the audit red only via the weaker D-row filter-text check, not via the data path that actually went black.
result.catch: Two things: (1) Add verification rows that quote 'grep -n res:// physics/schwarzschild.gd', 'ls data/lens', and the lens-assets Makefile recipe, then reconcile the DYNAMIC witnesses and M1–M3 kill conditions with whatever filenames/extensions the code truly constructs — the current .bin witnesses contradict the doc's own V8 observation. (2) The acceptance commands grep and unzip paths under .godot/tmp/ (AC3, AC5, AC6, AC7) while the design recipes write to $(SCRATCH); the doc never defines or verifies that $(SCRATCH) is .godot/tmp, so AC3/AC7 may reference nonexistent files.
result.proposed_fix: Add verification-log row V20: 'grep -n "res://" physics/schwarzschild.gd' plus 'ls -la data/lens/' and 'grep -n lens Makefile' (the lens-assets recipe), quoting the observed constructor line and staged filenames. Then either (a) if the code does build res://data/lens/lens_fwd.bin etc., quote that line verbatim and resolve the V8 parenthetical (why .json files are packed in a clone where the .bins are fetched) by noting .json is auto-packed source data; or (b) if the code now loads lens_fwd.json/lens_inv.json, rewrite the DYNAMIC row witnesses to the .json names, rewrite M1–M3's kill conditions to rest on the D-row filter-text check alone (a .json witness cannot fail F under 'data/lens/*.json'), and reword AC4's dev.23 claim accordingly. Independently, replace '.godot/tmp/…' in AC3, AC5–7 with '$(SCRATCH)/…' (or add a verification row 'grep -n SCRATCH Makefile' proving the mapping) and add a row verifying the Problem-section claim 'nothing in make test relates res:// paths to export_presets.cfg' (e.g., 'grep -rn export_presets Makefile tests/ tools/').
